priorities.experiment: SSDD image-level / annotation-level robustness and bootstrap CI
priorities.reason: SSDD is the newest external positive source, but the current artifact is Pfa-level aggregate only. Per-image or per-annotation deltas would answer the most likely reviewer question: whether gains are broad or driven by a small subset.

priorities.experiment: AISTAP + IPIX paired bootstrap / confidence interval reporting
priorities.reason: The main wins are already present; confidence intervals convert win-count evidence into reviewer-facing uncertainty evidence.

priorities.experiment: Formal combined full-asset protocol gate over simMed + simWind
priorities.reason: The cross-condition summary already passes on both assets, but the named finished-detector protocol artifact currently emphasizes simMed. A single combined gate would make the in-domain claim easier to defend.

priorities.experiment: Final-state sensitivity across seed / rank / hidden width on full assets
priorities.reason: The sample branch has stability checks, but a reviewer may ask whether the saved full-asset detector is seed-sensitive. Run only if manuscript time allows, because a weak seed may force more explanation.

priorities.experiment: Additional classical detector baselines beyond raw CFAR and low-rank residual
priorities.reason: This could answer baseline-strength criticism, but only helps if implemented cleanly and fairly. A rushed CA/OS/GOCA/SOCA comparison could create new reviewer attack surface.
